image_location_description: Bottom of image (under the feet): small rectangular pedestal, dark base with a white front edge.

steps.title: Start base footprint
steps.description: Place 2x Plate 2x2 (3022) Black side-by-side to make 4x2.

steps.title: Complete 4x4 base
steps.description: Add 1x Plate 2x2 (3022) Dark Bluish Gray and 1x Plate 2x2 (3022) White to form 4x4.

steps.title: Stiffen the middle
steps.description: On top, add 2x Plate 1x2 (3023) Dark Bluish Gray across center seams.

steps.title: Add center top tile
steps.description: Place 1x Tile 2x2 (2420) Black centered on the top surface.

steps.title: Fill top in black
steps.description: Add 3x Tile 1x2 (2412b) Black around the center tile (leave front edge open).

steps.title: Clean white front edge
steps.description: Place 2x Tile 1x2 (3069b) White along the front edge as a crisp border.
